arms.F: A0 research_now, equal weight, next-session adjusted-open fill (m3l_forward/forward_ledger.py unchanged); the paper book of record
arms.FB: F minus B1-restricted new entries; shadow measurement series
arms.FQ: F minus (B1 or Q1)-restricted new entries; analysis_pending / analysis_incomplete slots held as cash; shadow measurement series

B1.patterns: PREREG_m3n.json baseline_B, sha256 eafda74379c4c7bf1009fc86ff4a72e768b5f54bc83521e580cd1d227889070c, via scratch/rev23/m3n/baseline_b.py unchanged
B1.item_time: SEC acceptance (accepted_at) of the item's filing
B1.name: deterministic text rule (3N baseline B); never called verified

status.occurred: acts only when occurred_on is verified and within 180 days before T
status.occurred_on_verified: parses as a date (Month D, YYYY | Mon. D, YYYY | D Month YYYY | YYYY-MM-DD) and the same (year, month, day) is printed in at least one cited item
status.undated: missing or unparseable occurred_on: escalation, does not act
status.date_unsupported: date printed in no cited item: escalation, does not act
status.escalation: logged and queued for 3P reanalysis; no change to any series (SPEC_factor_led_v2 section 4)

A1S.analysis_pending: no completed run at the fill open: slot held as cash in FQ, entered at the first session open after completion unless Q1-restricted
A1S.analysis_incomplete: both runner attempts failed or the task is malformed: slot held as cash in FQ until the next formation
A1S.partial_analysis: material_events ok but run status not complete: eligible, flagged partial_analysis

E1.restricted_not_held: new_entry_restricted; weight redistributed equally over the arm's entered names
E1.restricted_held: pending_reunderwriting flag; held at equal weight; no paper sale
E1.exit: only when the name leaves A0's book
E1.expiry: next formation, where the restriction is re-derived

decision_time: witnessed updated_at of the decision run forward_ledger.py selects (last verified scoring run before the fill session open)

analysis.tasks: all seven SPEC_m3m tasks plus material_events
analysis.builder: v7 (rs2-local review-2026-10/m3n-v6, at d2f3f15 with contract v3); one version per formation

labels.FQ_FB_after_3N_close: paper_post_3N, from the next formation on; no row is relabelled

measures.turnover: one-way, 0.5 * sum(abs(target - drifted pre-trade weight)), including forced exits
measures.event_response: per restriction: restricted name return over the restriction period vs the arm book; per later-found critical event on a book name: whether and when B1/Q1 restricted it
measures.operations: analyses per formation, completion rate, T-to-completion latency, pending and incomplete counts, GPU hours
